info.headline: Severe Cyclonic Storm approaching Konkan coast
info.description: Severe cyclonic storm likely to cross Maharashtra coast between Raigad and Ratnagiri. Fishermen are advised not to venture into the sea. Coastal residents should follow evacuation advisories.
info.instruction: Move to designated cyclone shelters if instructed. Keep emergency kit ready. Avoid coastal areas.

area.areaDesc: Konkan coast: Mumbai, Raigad, Ratnagiri coastal belt

info.headline: Heavy rainfall warning for Konkan and coastal Karnataka
info.description: Heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places likely over Konkan and coastal Karnataka during next 48 hours.
